_about: Kinds every project has (docs/library.md): a project's own kinds in presets/<project>.json add to these and replace one of the same name. docs/3d-characters.md has how a 3D character is made, slot by slot.

character3d.description: A 3D character for a game: concept, front A-pose, textured mesh, rig, animation clips, previews, and the files the game loads (FBX for Unity, GLB for the web).

concept.description: A full-body turnaround (front, side, back) to model from.

params.prompt: Character turnaround sheet of {name}, {look}: front, side and back views, full body, neutral A-pose, plain light grey background, even light. {style} {feedback}

apose.description: The front view alone: the whole body standing straight in an A-pose, facing the viewer, on a plain background. What the mesh is made from.

params.prompt: Image 1 is a character sheet of {name}. Draw only the front view: the whole body from head to feet, standing straight, arms held 45 degrees down and away from the body, legs a little apart, facing the viewer, plain light grey background, even light, nothing else in the picture. {feedback}

mesh.description: The textured mesh made from the A-pose (no skeleton yet).

rig.description: The mesh with a Mixamo-named skeleton and skin weights (a GLB from Make-It-Animatable). Clips are retargeted onto this.

motion/*.description: A clip generated from a text prompt on the rig (data.prompt is the sentence). The GLB is this slot; the preview video is preview/{part}. For several takes, submit with params.takes and run library.judge on the preview slot against the same prompt. The GLB with the same take is the matching clip.

animation/*.description: One clip on the rig (a GLB with that animation, named like the slot: animation/walk holds "walk"). Its data.source names the motion to retarget: an asset (asset:<id>), a library clip (motion:ual1/Walk_Loop) or another slot (slot:project/entity/animation/walk), a Mixamo FBX, a GLB or a BVH.

preview/turntable.description: A video of the rig. mesh.rig files its walk video here. Making this slot on its own renders a turntable of the rest pose.

preview/*.description: A video of one clip (preview/walk shows animation/walk).

export/fbx.description: The FBX Unity imports: Mixamo bone names (Humanoid-ready), each clip a named take, 1 unit = 1 m. Make it with inputs.files = ["slot:./rig", "slot:./animation/walk", ...] to take those clips along.

export/glb.description: The GLB the web games load: one animation per clip. Make it with inputs.files = ["slot:./rig", "slot:./animation/walk", ...] to take those clips along.
